name: drugwar
description: The street-level drug war: a self-running turf tick where the Franchise, the Breakers, and the Glitch push zone_control influence back and forth across the Core, the Marquee, and the Yards on their own — the visible, low-stakes microcosm of the corp territory meta. Writes the shared zone_control substrate; emits drugwar.flip on a seizure. Home for the ambient 'living world' reactions that hang off those flips.
